periods.description: Mysterious ruin-origin monsters that attack humans and animals and require Drag-Rides for reliable defense.
periods.history: Abyss began emerging from ruins after Drag-Rides were discovered; they have caused disasters near ruins and remain a key reason ruins are guarded.
periods.goals: No human-like goal; normally attack living beings indiscriminately, though volume 1 shows flute-based control can direct them.
periods.structure: Creature types and swarms rather than social organization; includes Gargoyle-type and large slime-type Abyss in volume 1.
periods.leader: none normally; temporarily controlled by abyss-flute users
